clips.title: The story
paras: Dragonmurk is a sprawling, hazardous tract of southern Dustwallow Marsh swarming with black dragonspawn and hatchlings. Flanked by ancient ogre ruins and scorched caverns, it serves as the hostile outer perimeter for the brood of Onyxia.

Spanning the southern interior of Dustwallow Marsh, the Dragonmurk marks the threshold where damp wetlands give way to the dominion of the black dragonflight. The waterways and thick mud here crawl with black wyrmkins, dragonspawn, and ravenous whelps. The surrounding landscape has suffered deeply from their presence; adjacent territories such as the ruined village of Stonemaul and the scorched cavern known as the Den of Flame have both fallen completely under the flight's territorial grip.
